scene: Inside the bathhouse lobby, three ticket desks offer departures across the city.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view inside the tiled bathhouse lobby. On the far left is the blue entrance curtain. To the left sits a steel counter displaying bento tickets. The grandfather stands holding his bicycle with plants beside an open canal gate showing a floating koi boat. On the right stands a turnstile leading toward the garden tram.
shown: a steel ticket counter with a bento express timetable on the left
an open canal gate with a moored wooden koi boat at centre
a green departure turnstile leading to the garden tram on the right
